Hush, Full Moon Ritual. The veil thins violently tonight.

This October 5th Full Moon in Aries opposes the Sun in Libra, hitting 12 degrees of Aries. Mars rules this volatile Fire event, exploding your 1st House self-image against your 7th House relationships ruled by Venus.

In love, a hidden truth surfaces this week, forcing a choice between comfort and raw, painful honesty. In career, the Moon trines your 10th House sector, signaling a bold raise request or sudden public recognition. Expect intense emotional waves throughout the night.

Chiron conjuncts this lunation in Aries, while Venus Retrograde shadows your past contracts. Your North Node in Pisces demands you stop serving others to finally heal your own spine.

Survive this by grounding firmly in the 4th House corner with salt water before bed.

Comment your specific sign below now for a private reading tonight.
